_comment: VS Code .vscode/mcp.json (servers, not mcpServers). Replace <YOU> with the
Windows account that ran the PLAXIS-MCP installer.
The password prompt that used to live here is gone on purpose: the profile
names a Windows Credential Manager target, and `serve --config` refuses to
start if any PLAXIS_* endpoint environment override is set.
Use Default Approvals -- not Bypass, not Autopilot.
